name: autoexec_script_version_param
label: Automation Custom Tool Parameter Table
description: The automation custom tool parameter table is used for related queries in automated processes and report queries.

fields.name: script_version_id
fields.description: Script version ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Parameter name, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Parameter type: output parameter, input parameter, primary key or unique identifier for the current table record.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Text, password, file, date, node information, global variables, JSON object, file path.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the script_version_id, key, mode fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
